title: finding(plugin-form): object-form's declared `modalCloseButton` is never read, so `modalCloseButton: false` still shows the modal's close button
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (b), declared and not enforced. `reach:` public door, measured once: rendered through `SchemaRenderer`, an `object-form` with `formType: 'modal'` and `modalCloseButton: false` still shows the close button (the objectui#10993 batch-1 dev's patch-round probe, report `5884902332` on objectui#10993). Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11050, whose contract review escalated it. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites (objectui `origin/main` `30f912a0d`)

- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: `ObjectFormSchema` declares `modalCloseButton?: boolean`, and it is one of the `object-view` form-slot keys.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`: the `object-form` registration declares the input `modalCloseButton` (boolean).
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`: forwards `modalCloseButton: schema.modalCloseButton` to the modal presentation.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`: declares `modalCloseButton?: boolean` in its schema type and never reads it; the dialog always renders its close button.

PR objectui#11050 rewrote the registration description to state this truth meanwhile (it used to say "honoured by ModalForm").

## Why it matters

A declared key the runtime ignores is the declared-not-enforced shape: an author (or an AI) sets it, gets no effect and no error.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The enforce-or-remove channel: either `ModalForm` honours it (hide the close button when `false`, keeping Escape and the cancel action as the ways out), or the key is retired from the type, the registration and the form-slot list. Whether the spec's `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` row declares it decides which (spec declaration first, per the base rule).

## Dedupe

The 1024 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `modalCloseButton`: 3 hits, objectui#6152 (open, a zod-mirror omission ledger, not the runtime read), PR objectui#10451 (closed, a registration census), PR objectui#11050 (the source);
- `ModalForm` near "close button": 0 hits;
- lit control `ModalForm`: 29 hits; absent control `qqzz_never_written_token_27182818`: 1 hit (objectui#11058, which quotes it as its own absent control).

None carries the runtime read.
